text: [laughing in disbelief] Eleven number sevens, and still not one Ronaldo! [laughs] Karma, my brother.
Portugal lose four-one to Denmark in Braga, their first game without Ronaldo. One question. Is it Jesus... or do you just miss Ronaldo?
[angry, fast] It's Jesus! His team, his plan, and Denmark ran in behind us all night long.
[sad, quiet] Twenty-three years he gave us. [sighs] One night without him, and look at this.
[passionate, raised voice] Stop crying about Ronaldo! It's one bad night. We're still top of the group. Give Jesus time.
[calm, firm] Neither. Højlund scored twice and nobody picked him up. That's on the players.
